propositions: not_a_bug close without a replacement ticket incorrectly routes to the completion verifier, which demands proof a nonexistent defect was fixed, making truthful closure impossible without --force
close_disposition.verdict() returns None when no replacement link exists for not_a_bug, causing fallthrough to full completion verification instead of minting a deterministic attestation
not_a_bug and escalated must be added to REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES so that --reason (or a live replacement link) is mandatory at write time, with write-side refusal if neither is provided
A live replacement link should be checked first (in REPLACEMENT_SATISFIES_REASON_CLASSES) to preserve precedence; --reason becomes the fallback when no replacement exists
escalated has an identical structural problem (no in-repo work performed, verifier unsatisfiable) and must follow the same reason-required pattern with --reason naming where the work was escalated to
